steps.name: Those who want power (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Lena] at the “Guild Inn”, go to [Yuran] at the “Luman Union Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Are you resting well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, okay. I came because I had something to tell you, but do you remember now?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The way you say it makes me feel like I couldn't remember because I was drinking? Well, it doesn’t matter… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: While you were resolving the matter at Magic Academy Zerenis, there was someone who came here to visit you.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The sight of him with short hair and glasses was impressive. He seemed to be from Gendiana or Eastland.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: He came here looking ordinary, but everyone was wary because he got the feeling that he was a powerful person hiding tremendous power.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: But the strength in her soft voice made everyone believe in her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yuran… I see. He is the first disciple of Jiscard, the Sword God, the leader of Eastland's Union of Light.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: A disciple of a person called the Sword God must not be an ordinary person. Anyway, when I heard from Einst that you had arrived, I told him your whereabouts.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (Perhaps His Majesty knew this too...)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: By the way, you don't have any complaints about me informing you of your whereabouts, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no complaints whatsoever. In any case, we live in a world where personal information becomes public property at some point.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know what you're talking about. Anyway, she asked me to come see her for a moment when you get back... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it urgent?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lena. I'll be back for a bit. Don't drink too much.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Got it. Instead, be sure not to be late on the day you receive the edict.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There you are, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on? I heard that you even visited the Guild Federation... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: First of all, I have to say I'm sorry. Actually, I didn't want to look for you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I tried to solve it, but I had no choice because the teacher told me to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. By the way, what did Jiscard say?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: This is a story about wool. Ul is the youngest of Master's students, but he is the most talented.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Even if you have talent, you never neglect it, and you have the sincerity to practice every day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Confidence is also quite high.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It only takes a moment for confidence to turn into arrogance. So, Master and I say don't do that, but it doesn't seem to fall on his ears.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Wool is in a very dangerous state right now. Because both Master and I ended up seeing ‘him’ in us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That? Who is he?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Let me tell you. His name is Baral… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Although I am known to be Master's first disciple, He was there before me.

lines.speaker: 유런
lines.text: Baral, like Ul, was a talented student and an excellent student who never neglected his training.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Although his abilities were outstanding, he could not protect everyone in the battle against the Deimos Church.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: At that moment, he felt that his skills were not enough and started to become more obsessed with power.  At some point, the sword I used to protect someone changed.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The Master told him to abandon his obsession with power, but he did not listen.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then, something happened at the entrance to Jisk's territory, where entry was blocked... . He stopped guild members of the battle guild who had been trying to stop him according to his master's will... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I really feel sorry for bringing up this kind of story. I hope %s can convince me.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: This is something that Master also asks of you. I trust you completely... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't have the skills to aim at Ul, so how... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: We might listen to %s who is now doing Iris's job. It's the same power, but the direction of use is different... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say so, I will go to Ul. But, can’t you see the wool? Where did you go?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I heard that they were going to the Amalun Desert for training.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then, I will find it and persuade you as soon as possible. Jiscard and Yuran are worried.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (Yu-ran bows his head and asks for this task.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Then I'll come back.

steps.name: Those who want power (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Matu] in the “Hall of Rest” and report to [Tiya] in the “Amalun Desert”.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I felt like the star's movement was a little different, and that was Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Tiya. I'd like to talk at length, but I'm a little busy right now, so I think I'll have to go right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you ever seen someone who looks like this? He's about this tall, and his hair is like this, so he looks a little arrogant.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain wool briefly using hand gestures and gestures.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, I saw a person go to the Hall of Rest. I told him not to go in because it was a dangerous place, but he just went in.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The expression and atmosphere were a little strange.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I had no choice but to wait until he came out, and Adventurer happened to come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hall of Rest, what is the condition there now?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Would you like to go in there? The god of the dead, his ominous power still remains in a subtle way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go because I have been asked to do something.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Then, would you please come by my side for a moment?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (Tiya holds %s's hands. After a while, a language that seems to come from another world comes from Tiya's mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you talking about the world Tiya was in?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, it is an ancient language of our world. I don't know the details either... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: This is what my mother used to say when she prayed that nothing bad would happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Please be careful.

steps.name: Those who want power (4)
steps.objective: Go to [Ruin] at the “Underground City Construction Site”.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Adventurer, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. I found traces of Wool, but it seemed like he had already left. Have you seen him?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, I saw him coming out of the Hall of Rest. I grabbed him and asked him to wait a moment, but he shook me off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you say something?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I can't stop, I have to do more, it's not enough... , there were only stories like this.  It looks like… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tiya, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: … Still, I’m worried about him.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: It was an expression that yearned for power. They want power and are obsessed with it... . It was like that back then too. My younger brother, who made a contract with the god of the dead, also had that look on his face.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… . I don't know what's going on or not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tiya, so where did Wool go?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I went towards Tartarus. They say there is a place in Tartarus full of demons. Did they really go there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think so. There is a place where the owner, Shinik, imprisons demons and monsters. Hell's room... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much princess. I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer. Please take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess I'll have to go to the underground city construction site and ask Ruin if he's seen Wool. Then, shall we go?)

steps.name: Those who want power (5)
steps.objective: Go to [Ul] in the “Room of Hell”.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: What's going on at the construction site? Do you ever have to go to the Hell Room again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… . I came here to look for someone at the request of someone I know.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I don't know who you're looking for, but did that person enter the hellish room?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Is the person you're looking for a kid? Looks incredibly cocky?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain Ul’s appearance to Ruin.)

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Yes, that's right. That little guy took a walk around the underground city construction site and looked unsatisfied.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... That's right.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: cry? Is that little boy's name Ul? If it's wool, is it silver sword dragon wool? The youngest disciple of the swordsman Jiscard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: This is my first time seeing a disciple of the famous Giscard. haha .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: What can I say, that expression makes me feel uneasy because I feel like I'm looking at Landain from before. I don't know who it is, but I guess I asked you a favor because I was worried about that little boy.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Because you are the type of person who uses your power when it is needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still don't know how to use my power.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Too much humility can be toxic. At times like that, you're showing off and showing off.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: It hasn't been long since the little boy entered the hell room, so hurry up. If we go fast, we might be able to meet in the middle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Ruin.  Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s quickly find out where Ul is training….)

steps.name: Those who want power (6)
steps.objective: Go to [Yuran] at the “Luman Coalition Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There you are. Someone came, but you don’t even pretend to know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No. I was thinking about how much training I should do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because I have something to say.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Also, Sister Yuran must have sent you because of unnecessary worries.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know it well. At this point, aren’t you doing it on purpose?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I don't want to talk about this anymore. Because there is no conclusion anyway. Rather, you.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Your power feels more and more strange. Maybe you... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Ul raises his sword and holds it in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, suddenly… .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Ul puts away his sword and laughs.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Sorry, I was mistaken. The room in the abyss was so full of dirty energy that I felt strange for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought you wanted to spar with me.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: That's funny. Do you think you'll be a good match for me?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (When Wool smiles lightly, a huge amount of energy explodes and disappears around him.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I will accept you as an official sparring partner soon. Until then, work hard to increase your strength.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I will decline that.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: That's because I want to try it. Make a formal request. You also killed the chattering crow here, right? Because I was interested.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That said, back then... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Well, that's enough. Then we'll talk later. I'll just practice some more, so fuck off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I say to Yuran?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Tell your sister not to worry. Since it's just normal training, nothing really will happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it when you talk like that. I'll go back now.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Ul continues to swing his sword even after %s's appearance disappears. After a while, a sign of suspicious people is heard from somewhere to stop Ull's sword.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (There’s a suspicious vibe. Shall we watch for a moment?)
(A man and a woman with red hair seem to be slowly returning from somewhere. However, they are frowning as if things did not go well.)

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: How long do I have to walk? As soon as you use the magic stone... .

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Mara, how many times have I told you this? He said he had no choice if he didn't want to be caught by Shinik. You came all the way here by erasing your traces and then you say something like that?

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Okay, stop. Rather, do you need something like a trace of the demon world that the devil is leading? We still have a lot of magic stones left. With this amount, something like the Morse Kingdom... .

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: (When Mara takes out a bag of magic stones and shows it, Ban snatches it and throws it on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Van, what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: You believe that everything is possible with this magic stone, but we have already failed several times. Let's think a little differently!!

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: This is all because of that goddess and the guy who follows her. He interfered with our plans at every turn... . Next time we meet, I will definitely kill you.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: I definitely said that if I sign with that guy, I can get a spot on the continent. But what is this… .

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: That's over now. Don't even think about it, damn it. The snake-like Prince Nox doesn't listen... Anyway, I have no choice but to see it through to the end.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: We have to do our best before the Morse Kingdom falls apart.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Okay, brother. Let's go to Oneiro... . But that magic stone… .

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Just throw it away. It is a defective product that cannot be used properly anyway.
(As Ban and Mara disappear toward the entrance to the Maw Chamber, Ul slowly walks out of the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Were those guys the culprits? . But it seems like this magic stone still has some magical power left in it?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You are here. Where was the wool?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The ‘Room of Hell’ in Tartarus. Still, it wasn't difficult to find wool since I had been there once.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: After all, it is a room in the abyss... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There was a time when Tartarus was in trouble due to Malphas flowing into the Hell Chamber from the Demon World.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Many people tried to defeat Malphas and take Shinik's prize, but no one was able to defeat him. Some people lost their lives and had their souls stolen.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Ul also attempted to defeat Malphas, but was injured by a man named Landain and had no choice but to rest.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I tried to defeat Malphas once again, but Adventurer, who had already left on his trip, had already taken care of him.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Although he doesn't show it on the outside, he is probably concerned about %s's condition.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: A being who defeated a target that could not be defeated... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you trying to tell me that Wool seems obsessed with power because of me? I just did what I had to do.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Sorry if it sounded that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren't you treating me like a child too much? Ul told Yu-ran that since it was just general training, nothing would really happen... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, I understand. I will inform my teacher as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And from now on, I hope you won't ask me to do anything like looking for wool.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Iris, are you training well? I didn't have a chance to see the main body... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If you say the main body... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. I'm probably concentrating on my training, but I'm wondering if I'm disturbing you for no reason... . I'm going to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, then I hope everything goes well on your way there.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (When %s's figure disappears into the distance of Luman, Iris slowly approaches Yuran.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Today’s training ended early. Bilbrat said he was tired of it now... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The main body has arrived.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah… … .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please be on time. As Iris mentioned, %s may be affected. He was there just a moment ago.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, I will. sorry. instead… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please don't use him or her to find out.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It is not a use. I just wanted to know... . What if, what if.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If anything goes wrong, Jin and I will cut him down ourselves.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That will never happen. Because he will never be like that. Because I don't want to.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Not everyone hopes for the worst... .
